basics.name: Erfan Eivazi
basics.label: Software Engineer | Backend Developer
basics.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and evolving enterprise software and web-based information systems.
Experienced across the full software development lifecycle, from business process and requirements analysis through system design, implementation, delivery, and long-term evolution, with a strong focus on clean, maintainable backend architectures.
Hands-on expertise spans enterprise web applications, GIS and spatial data, data processing, dynamic reporting, automation, and financial technology projects.
Contributes technical leadership through architectural decision-making, code reviews, technical debt planning, continuous refactoring, developer mentoring, knowledge sharing, and close collaboration with technical and DevOps teams in Agile/Scrum environments.

work.summary: Engineering software and information systems company delivering enterprise web platforms for gas network simulation, forecasting, monitoring, analysis, and operational data management.
highlights: Serve as a Senior Software Engineer and Backend Developer across multiple enterprise projects for the National Iranian Gas Company, including gas network simulation, consumption forecasting, and transmission network monitoring systems.

Contribute throughout the full SDLC in an Agile/Scrum environment, collaborating with the technical lead on requirements analysis and system design and translating complex operational needs into maintainable software solutions.
Provide technical leadership through code reviews, Clean Code practices, developer mentoring, knowledge sharing, and efforts to strengthen collaboration across the development team.

Plan and manage technical debt through continuous refactoring, including redesigning the BackgroundTasks and InprocCore packages with Clean Architecture principles to improve separation of concerns, extensibility, and long-term maintainability.
Designed and developed the backend of the SGN gas network simulation platform, enabling static and dynamic pressure-flow analysis for gas distribution engineers and analysts.
Contributed to a gas consumption forecasting system that analyzes historical consumption data and temperature variations to support gas-demand analysis.
Developed a logsheet data-entry and monitoring system for station and control-valve data, emergency events, and operational reporting across the gas transmission network.
Designed and developed an OGC-compliant GIS Server providing WFS, TMS, and WMS services, along with five tools for validating and cleansing geographic data in accordance with GIS-Ready guidelines.
Built a weather-data ingestion module integrating the Iran Meteorological Organization FTP service and multiple external websites through web scraping.

Developed a dynamic reporting system with an advanced QueryBuilder for comparative and aggregated reports, and implemented Excel exports, template-driven report generation, and macro-enabled reporting workflows.
Support DevOps and application-delivery workflows and contribute to Angular-based frontend development when cross-functional project needs require it.

Technologies: C# | .NET | ASP.NET Core | SQL Server | Clean Architecture | CQRS | Microservices | gRPC | RabbitMQ | NestJS | TypeORM | Angular | TypeScript | RxJS | GIS | OGC Standards | OpenLayers | GeoServer | Azure DevOps | Docker

work.summary: Software solutions company delivering business platforms, recruitment and search products, and mobile applications.
highlights: Designed and developed ParadiseHub's CRM, a multi-branch workspace-management platform built on a fully NoSQL data model and supporting 11 distinct user roles.
Modeled and implemented branch-specific rental plans for shared and dedicated offices, desks, and seats, including online rental and renewal workflows with payment-gateway integration.
Built management and reservation workflows for meeting rooms and conference halls, along with configurable service sales and wallet-based purchases for branch-specific member offerings.

Delivered financial-management capabilities covering discounts, sales reporting, and invoice administration, as well as proposal-submission and multi-stage application workflows for the company's accelerator program.
Designed and implemented an advanced Elasticsearch query-building interface for efficiently searching large volumes of unstructured and filtered data.
Contributed as a Backend Developer to HR and recruitment products, including IranHR, a job-search engine, and other web-based platforms.
Developed backend functionality and data-related components for the mobile game "Che-Kalameh".
Technologies: JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | Angular | MongoDB | Elasticsearch | REST APIs | Git

work.summary: Intensive full-stack web development bootcamp focused on practical software engineering and product delivery.
highlights: Built a job-market data pipeline that scraped and processed listings from three major Iranian employment websites and powered a job-search engine with search and filtering capabilities.
Applied the MEAN stack in hands-on projects while studying networking, database design, Agile methodologies, and end-to-end software delivery workflows.
Ranked first in the bootcamp and received an invitation to join FuTech Group as a Software Developer.
Technologies: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | MySQL | Git

work.summary: Architecture and technology studio specializing in interactive installations and technology-driven advertising structures.
highlights: Developed control software for an interactive Smart Wall installation that used sensors to detect pedestrians and coordinate kinetic and lighting effects.
Programmed embedded controllers to orchestrate multiple actuators and LED lighting systems in response to sensor input.
Collaborated with architecture and fabrication specialists to integrate embedded software reliably with the physical installation.
Technologies: C | AVR MCU | Arduino | IR Sensors | Servo Motors | LED Lighting

work.summary: Manufacturer of radiometric measurement instruments and radiation-monitoring systems.
highlights: Enhanced radiation-monitoring software to support the simultaneous operation of up to four connected detectors.
Implemented configurable radiation-alarm thresholds and a software interface for transmitting control commands to the hardware panel.

Developed software-hardware communication and real-time monitoring interfaces, streamlining the operator workflow by moving alarm configuration into the application and eliminating the need for direct hardware-panel access.
Technologies: C# | Windows Forms | USB | Serial Communication | RS-232

work.summary: Independent engineering projects focused on embedded control, monitoring, and software-hardware integration.
highlights: Designed and implemented a prototype access-control and silo-capacity monitoring system, including its software user interface.
Designed and built a timer-based parking-gate control circuit with automatic closing, vehicle detection, and obstacle detection.
Technologies: C | C# | AVR | Arduino | Windows Forms | Serial Communication | RS-232 | Sensors | Servo Motors | LED Control
